## 1. InputEnvelope (P06.1)

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Operations\Invocation\Enums;

use CoreX\Attributes\Api;

/** Named input envelope. Rejecting undeclared fields is not part of the envelope and cannot be disabled. */
#[Api(since: '1.0')]
enum InputEnvelope: string
{
    case Query = 'query';
    case JsonObject = 'json-object';

    public static function forMethod(string $method): self
    {
        return strtoupper($method) === 'GET' ? self::Query : self::JsonObject;
    }
}
```

```php
// OperationDispatcher::input()
$input = match ($operation->inputEnvelope) {
    InputEnvelope::Query => $this->query->read($request),
    InputEnvelope::JsonObject => $this->jsonObject->read($request),
};
$allowed = array_unique(array_map(static fn (string $key): string => explode('.', $key)[0], array_keys($operation->inputRules)));
$undeclared = array_values(array_diff(array_keys($input), $allowed));

if ($undeclared !== []) {
    sort($undeclared);

    throw new ApiError(OperationsErrorCode::UndeclaredFields, 422, 'Input contains undeclared fields.', JsonDocuments::capture(['fields' => $undeclared]));
}
```

```php
// JsonObjectEnvelopeReader::read()
if ($request->query->count() !== 0) {
    throw new ApiError(OperationsErrorCode::InputEnvelopeInvalid, 422, 'Query parameters are not accepted with a request body.');
}
if (! $request->isJson()) {
    throw new ApiError(OperationsErrorCode::UnsupportedMediaType, 415, 'A JSON request body is required.');
}
// json_decode → JsonException | not an object → InputEnvelopeInvalid, 'A JSON object body is required.'
```

## 3. problem+json — до и после (P06.1)

Запрос `POST /api/v1/notes` с телом `{"title":"x","color":"red"}`, `Accept: application/json`, поле `color` не объявлено.

До (envelope, т.к. `Accept: application/json`):

```json
{"data":null,"error":{"code":"operations.validation_failed","message":"Input contains undeclared fields.","category":"validation","path":null,"retryable":false,"details":{}},"meta":{"request_id":"r-1","correlation_id":"c-1","api_version":"v1"}}
```

После (`Content-Type: application/problem+json`, статус 422, заголовки `X-Request-ID`, `Cache-Control: no-store`):

```json
{"type":"urn:corex:problem:operations.undeclared_fields","title":"Input contains undeclared fields.","status":422,"detail":"Input contains undeclared fields.","code":"operations.undeclared_fields","category":"validation","retryable":false,"details":{"fields":["color"]},"request_id":"r-1","correlation_id":"c-1","api_version":"v1"}
```

```php
// ProblemDetailsSerializer::error()
$descriptor = $error->errorDescriptor();
$definition = $this->problems->fromWire($descriptor->code);
$body = [
    'type' => $definition->type,
    'title' => $definition->title,
    'status' => $error->status,
    'detail' => $error->getMessage(),
    'code' => $descriptor->code,
    'category' => $descriptor->category->value,
    'retryable' => $descriptor->retryable,
    'details' => (object) $descriptor->details,
    'request_id' => $metadata->requestId,
    'correlation_id' => $metadata->correlationId,
    'api_version' => $metadata->version,
];
if ($descriptor->path !== null) {
    $body['path'] = $descriptor->path;
}
```

Успех после: `{"data":{…},"meta":{"request_id":…,"correlation_id":…,"api_version":…}}` — без `"error":null`.

## 4. Тесты P06.1

a) `ErrorRepresentationTest` — датасет `Accept`: `''`, `application/json`, `application/problem+json`, `text/html`, `*/*;q=0` → всегда 4xx/5xx с `application/problem+json`, никогда 406. Утверждения: `type` = `ProblemRegistry::fromWire(code)->type`, `title` = `->title`, `detail` = сообщение, отсутствуют ключи `instance`, `message`, `error`, `data`.
Полнота: `foreach (app(ProblemRegistry::class)->all() as $definition)` → сериализация `new ApiError($definition->code, $definition->defaultStatus, 'x')` без исключения, `title` совпадает.
Негативный контроль (в Completion Notes, не в дереве): заменить `$definition->title` на `$error->getMessage()` — тест `title` краснеет.

b) `InputEnvelopeTest`:

| Запрос | Ожидание |
|:--|:--|
| `GET ?title=x` (объявлен `title`) | 200 |
| `GET ?title=x&color=red` | 422 `operations.undeclared_fields`, `details.fields` = `["color"]` |
| `POST` `Content-Type: text/plain` | 415 `operations.unsupported_media_type` |
| `POST ?a=1` JSON-тело | 422 `operations.input_envelope_invalid` |
| `POST` тело `[1,2]` | 422 `operations.input_envelope_invalid` |
| `POST` тело `{"title":"x","b":1,"a":2}` | 422 `operations.undeclared_fields`, `fields` = `["a","b"]` |

## 6. CloudEvents (P06.3)

```php
#[Api(since: '1.0')]
interface CloudEventCodec
{
    /** Internal transport: full CloudEvents 1.0 structured JSON with corex extensions. */
    public function encode(MessageEnvelope $message): string;

    /** External receiver: core attributes only; `data` replaces the payload. @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public function encodeExternal(MessageEnvelope $message, array $data): string;

    public function decode(string $json): MessageEnvelope;
}
```

Worked example. Вход:

```php
new MessageEnvelope(
    messageId: '01J9Z6Q4A7', source: 'axiomasoft/corex-custom-fields', name: 'customfields.attribute.changed', contractVersion: 1,
    occurredAt: new DateTimeImmutable('2026-10-03T08:00:00.123456Z'), scope: ['workspace' => 'w-7', 'account' => 'a-1'],
    payload: new MessagePayload(['attribute' => 'color']), piiClass: PiiClass::None, subject: 'attr-42',
    correlationId: 'c-1', metadata: ['traceparent' => '00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01'],
);
// контракт зарегистрирован с dataSchema: 'https://schemas.example.test/customfields.attribute.changed/v1.json'
```

`encode()` — байт-в-байт (одна строка; здесь перенесено для чтения):

```json
{"specversion":"1.0","id":"01J9Z6Q4A7","source":"axiomasoft/corex-custom-fields","type":"customfields.attribute.changed.v1",
"subject":"attr-42","time":"2026-10-03T08:00:00.123456Z","datacontenttype":"application/json",
"dataschema":"https://schemas.example.test/customfields.attribute.changed/v1.json",
"corexscope":"{\"account\":\"a-1\",\"workspace\":\"w-7\"}","corexpii":"none","corexenvelope":1,"corexcorrelation":"c-1",
"traceparent":"00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01","data":{"attribute":"color"}}
```

Отсутствующие необязательные атрибуты (`subject`, `dataschema`, `corexcorrelation`, `corexcausation`, `traceparent`, `tracestate`) не выводятся, `null` не пишется.
Значение `corexpii` — `PiiClass::value` (`none`, `pseudonymous`, `personal`).

`encodeExternal($message, ['attribute' => 'color'])`:

```json
{"specversion":"1.0","id":"01J9Z6Q4A7","source":"axiomasoft/corex-custom-fields","type":"customfields.attribute.changed.v1",
"time":"2026-10-03T08:00:00.123456Z","datacontenttype":"application/json",
"data":{"attribute":"color"}}
```

b) `CloudEventCodecTest` — негативы `decode` (каждый → `InvalidMessage`): `specversion` `"0.3"`; лишний атрибут `"foo":"x"`; `data_base64`; `type` `"customfields.attribute.changed"` без `.vN`; `time` без зоны; `corexscope` не JSON-объект. Encode-негативы: метаданные `{"x-tenant":"a"}` → `InvalidMessage`; `source` `"has space"` → `InvalidMessage` в конструкторе конверта.
Round-trip: `decode(encode($m)) == $m` для примера выше и для конверта без необязательных полей.

c) URI-reference validator (D92). `packages/core/src/Messaging/Internal/UriReference.php` below is a worked skeleton; add the namespace and normal style/imports at execution. Grammar: [RFC 3986 Appendix A](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3986.html#appendix-A). It validates generic syntax, not scheme-specific network policy. The grammar permits an empty reference, but `MessageEnvelope` keeps its existing nonempty/≤128 source checks. `dataSchema` uses `isAbsolute` (scheme required, no fragment), per the absolute-URI production.

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/** @internal RFC 3986 Appendix A generic syntax, not network reachability or scheme policy. */
final class UriReference
{
    private const string Pattern = <<<'REGEX'
~\A(?:(?&uri)|(?&relative))(?:\?(?&query))?(?:\#(?&query))?\z
(?(DEFINE)
    (?<unreserved> [A-Za-z0-9._\~-] )
    (?<subdelims> [!$&'()*+,;=] )
    (?<pct> %[0-9A-Fa-f]{2} )
    (?<pchar> (?&unreserved)|(?&pct)|(?&subdelims)|[:@] )
    (?<segment> (?&pchar)* )
    (?<segmentnz> (?&pchar)+ )
    (?<segmentnc> (?:(?&unreserved)|(?&pct)|(?&subdelims)|@)+ )
    (?<abempty> (?:/(?&segment))* )
    (?<absolute> /(?:(?&segmentnz)(?:/(?&segment))*)? )
    (?<rootless> (?&segmentnz)(?:/(?&segment))* )
    (?<noscheme> (?&segmentnc)(?:/(?&segment))* )
    (?<scheme> [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]* )
    (?<userinfo> (?:(?&unreserved)|(?&pct)|(?&subdelims)|:)* )
    (?<regname> (?:(?&unreserved)|(?&pct)|(?&subdelims))* )
    (?<octet> 25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9][0-9]|[0-9] )
    (?<ipv4> (?&octet)\.(?&octet)\.(?&octet)\.(?&octet) )
    (?<h16> [0-9A-Fa-f]{1,4} )
    (?<ls32> (?&h16):(?&h16)|(?&ipv4) )
    (?<ipv6>
        (?:(?&h16):){6}(?&ls32)
      | ::(?:(?&h16):){5}(?&ls32)
      | (?&h16)?::(?:(?&h16):){4}(?&ls32)
      | (?:(?:(?&h16):){0,1}(?&h16))?::(?:(?&h16):){3}(?&ls32)
      | (?:(?:(?&h16):){0,2}(?&h16))?::(?:(?&h16):){2}(?&ls32)
      | (?:(?:(?&h16):){0,3}(?&h16))?::(?&h16):(?&ls32)
      | (?:(?:(?&h16):){0,4}(?&h16))?::(?&ls32)
      | (?:(?:(?&h16):){0,5}(?&h16))?::(?&h16)
      | (?:(?:(?&h16):){0,6}(?&h16))?::
    )
    (?<ipfuture> [vV][0-9A-Fa-f]+\.(?:(?&unreserved)|(?&subdelims)|:)+ )
    (?<host> \[(?:(?&ipv6)|(?&ipfuture))\]|(?&regname) )
    (?<authority> (?:(?&userinfo)@)?(?&host)(?::[0-9]*)? )
    (?<hier> //(?&authority)(?&abempty)|(?&absolute)|(?&rootless)| )
    (?<relative> //(?&authority)(?&abempty)|(?&absolute)|(?&noscheme)| )
    (?<uri> (?&scheme):(?&hier) )
    (?<query> (?:(?&pchar)|[/?])* )
)
~xD
REGEX;

    public static function isValid(string $value): bool
    {
        return preg_match(self::Pattern, $value) === 1;
    }

    public static function isAbsolute(string $value): bool
    {
        return self::isValid($value)
            && preg_match('/\A[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:/D', $value) === 1
            && ! str_contains($value, '#');
    }
}
```

Positive source cases: `corex/relay`, `axiomasoft/corex-custom-fields`, `fixture-address/1`, `./1:foo`, `/a/b`, `../a`, `?q=a%20b`, `#fragment`, `urn:corex:source`, `https://example.test/a%20b?q=x#f`, `https://[::1]/`, `https://[2001:db8::1]:443/a`, `https://[::ffff:192.0.2.1]/`, `https://[v1.a:b]/`.
Negative cases (constructor → `InvalidMessage`): empty/129-byte source; space/control/Unicode; `%`, `%zz`, `a%2`, `1:foo`, `http://[not-ip]/`, `https://[::1`, `https://[1::2::3]/`, `https://host:port/`, `https://host/a[b]`, `https://host/#a#b`.
`dataSchema`: accept `urn:corex:schema:v1`, `https://schemas.example.test/v1.json`; reject relative path, malformed percent/IP-literal and fragment-bearing URI. Source URI-reference permits a fragment; dataSchema absolute-URI does not.

The external profile always omits dataschema. Redaction test fixture: internal schema requires `{id, secret}`, internal data supplies both; projector returns `{id}`. Internal encode retains the schema; external encode contains `{id}` only and has no dataschema, so it never claims the redacted object satisfies that internal schema.

## 7. Вебхуки: причины и бюджет (P06.4)

```php
#[Api(since: '1.0')]
enum WebhookFailureReason: string
{
    case EndpointChanged = 'webhook_endpoint_changed';
    case AckUnknown = 'ack_unknown';
    case EndpointGone = 'endpoint_gone';
    case RedirectForbidden = 'redirect_forbidden';
    case HttpPermanent = 'http_permanent';
    case UrlForbidden = 'url_forbidden';
    case AddressNotAllowed = 'address_not_allowed';
    case EgressDenied = 'egress_denied';
    case TopicUnavailable = 'topic_unavailable';
    case PayloadTooLarge = 'payload_too_large';
    case Http429 = 'http_429';
    case Http5xx = 'http_5xx';
    case Http408 = 'http_408';
    case Http425 = 'http_425';
    case DnsUnavailable = 'dns_unavailable';
    case NetworkFailure = 'network_failure';
    case TransportFailure = 'transport_failure';
    case SigningUnavailable = 'signing_unavailable';
    case RetryExhausted = 'retry_exhausted';
    case RetryHorizonExhausted = 'retry_horizon_exhausted';

    public function isPermanent(): bool { /* EndpointChanged и восемь permanent case из D90; AckUnknown — transient */ }

    public function isTerminal(): bool { /* permanent или RetryExhausted/RetryHorizonExhausted */ }

    public static function fromHttpStatus(int $status): ?self { /* 2xx → null; таблица §7b */ }
}
```

Старые строки `webhook_url_forbidden` и `webhook_dns_unavailable` (текст исключений `WebhookUrlPolicy`) отображаются worker-ом в
`UrlForbidden`/`DnsUnavailable`; в `last_error` пишется только `->value` enum.

b) `WebhookFailureReasonTest`:

| Статус / событие | Причина | Permanent |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 200, 204 | `null` | — |
| 301, 307 | `redirect_forbidden` | да |
| 400, 401, 404 | `http_permanent` | да |
| 410 | `endpoint_gone` | да |
| 408 | `http_408` | нет |
| 425 | `http_425` | нет |
| 429 | `http_429` | нет |
| 500, 503 | `http_5xx` | нет |
| DNS не ответил | `dns_unavailable` | нет |
| адрес частной сети | `address_not_allowed` | да |
| egress-политика отказала | `egress_denied` | да |

Бюджет общий для `decide()` и `SqlWebhookDeliveryStore::recoverExpired()` через `budgetFailure(delivery, instant)`:
`attempt >= maxAttempts` → `RetryExhausted`; иначе `instant >= createdAt + retryHorizonSeconds` → `RetryHorizonExhausted`.
`decide` сначала сохраняет успех/постоянный отказ; для transient проверяет `now`, затем рассчитанный `next`.
Recovery проверяет `now`; pending attempt получает `outcome=unknown`, `error_code=AckUnknown->value`,
доставка — `dead` с причиной бюджета либо `retry` с `AckUnknown->value`. Никаких 12/72h в store.

`WebhookRetryBudgetTest`: обычная третья неудача при max=3 и восстановление expired lease при attempt=3 → dead;
max=20/attempt=12 → retry (старый лимит 12 не действует); horizon=3600, возраст=3600 и 7200 → dead/horizon;
возраст=3599, attempt=1 → retry/ack_unknown; одновременные лимиты → retry_exhausted; `next == horizon` → dead/horizon.
Общий бюджет не меняет fencing, 2xx success, 410 dead/disable и неизвестный исход пропавшего worker.

```php
// Internal retry result: array{status: 'succeeded'|'retry'|'dead', next: DateTimeImmutable, error: ?WebhookFailureReason}
// Public WebhookHttpResult constructor/property: ?WebhookFailureReason $errorCode (D92, Golden delta §4).
// Store helpers finishAttempt/rejectClaim accept ?WebhookFailureReason / WebhookFailureReason.
'last_error' => $decision['error']?->value,
'error_code' => $error?->value,
// recovery attempt error_code is AckUnknown->value, distinct from delivery budget exhaustion reason.
```

`WebhookFailureReasonTest` covers every enum case and producer; round-trip `WebhookFailureReason::from($persisted)`
for all non-null attempt/delivery reasons. `EndpointChanged` is permanent; `AckUnknown` transient.
`CurlWebhookTransport`, worker and test transports construct typed DTOs; arbitrary string transport reasons are no longer accepted.
`tests/Fixtures/LocalWebhookReceiver` bad signature returns `new WebhookHttpResult(401, null, null, 0)`; `WebhookLoadContourIntegrationTest` checks status 401 and null errorCode, preserving tampered-body rejection and no effects. `WebhookDeliveryTest` replaces its test-only `network_timeout` DTO/cause with `WebhookFailureReason::NetworkFailure`/value. No new reason case is needed: HTTP401 classifies HttpPermanent.
Store rejection uses `EndpointChanged`/`SigningUnavailable` and preserves dead/fenced state. Fanout writes `PayloadTooLarge->value`.

## 8. Модель угроз — скелет `docs/architecture/webhooks-threat-model.md` (P06.4)

```markdown

## Вебхуки: модель угроз



## Активы

Payload событий арендатора; ключи подписи; внутренняя сеть и metadata-адреса; квота исходящих соединений.

## Границы доверия

Арендатор → API подписок; worker → внешняя сеть; оператор → replay.

## Угрозы и контроли

| ID | Угроза | Контроль | Доказательство |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| T1 | URL ведёт во внутреннюю сеть или metadata (SSRF) | `WebhookUrlPolicy`: https, канонический хост, проверка всех A/AAAA, IPv4-mapped IPv6, org CIDR | `WebhookUrlPolicyTest` |
| T2 | DNS rebinding между проверкой и соединением | DNS pinning `CURLOPT_RESOLVE`, проверка peer IP | `WebhookTransportTest` |
| T3 | Редирект на внутренний адрес | редиректы не выполняются; 3xx — `redirect_forbidden`, dead | `WebhookFailureReasonTest` |
| T4 | Арендатор шлёт данные на неразрешённый хост | `WebhookEgressPolicy` при подписке и на каждой попытке | `WebhookEgressPolicyTest`, mutation `P06-egress-skip-on-delivery` |
| T5 | Подмена или повтор доставки | подпись Standard Webhooks по `id.timestamp.body`, ротация ключей | `WebhookSignatureTest` |
| T6 | Утечка внутреннего контекста получателю | внешний профиль CloudEvents без `corex*`, `subject`, trace | `CloudEventCodecTest` |
| T7 | Чужой арендатор получает payload | доставка привязана к subscription/scope/event; fan-out в транзакции арендатора | `WebhookFanoutTest` |
| T8 | Бесконечные ретраи, усиление нагрузки | бюджет попыток и горизонт, jitter, Retry-After с потолком | `WebhookRetryBudgetTest` |
| T9 | Replay на изменённый или запрещённый адрес | replay → pending → обычная попытка с текущими проверками; аудит причины | `WebhookEgressPolicyTest` (replay), `WebhookReplayTest` |
| T10 | Огромный payload | лимит тела, `payload_too_large`, dead без отправки | `WebhookFanoutTest` |

## Остаточные риски

Сетевой egress-фильтр (прокси, изоляция сети) — ответственность хоста; приложение его не заменяет.
```

Каждая строка «Доказательство» указывает на существующий после P06.4 тест; несуществующее имя — дефект документа (проверка: `grep -o '`[A-Za-z]*Test`' … | xargs -I{} sh -c 'git ls-files | grep -q {}.php'`).
